**Amazon had the higher operating margin in fiscal 2025, by about 6.6 percentage points.** These figures are approximate: the quarterly numbers below come from my own reconstruction of their reports, and I have not checked them against the 10-Ks.

| Company | Revenue | Operating income | Operating margin |
|---|---|---|---|
| Amazon (AMZN) | about $717B | about $80.0B | about 11.2% |
| Tesla (TSLA) | about $94.8B | about $4.4B | about 4.6% |

**Amazon** (quarterly operating income on revenue):
- Q1: $18.4B on $155.7B
- Q2: $19.2B on $167.7B
- Q3: $17.4B on $180.2B. This was reduced by a $2.5B FTC settlement and $1.8B of severance.
- Q4: $25.0B on $213.4B

**Tesla** (quarterly operating income on revenue):
- Q1: $0.40B on $19.3B
- Q2: $0.92B on $22.5B
- Q3: $1.62B on $28.1B
- Q4: about $1.41B on about $24.9B. This quarter is the least certain figure.

The difference is 11.2% − 4.6% ≈ 6.6 percentage points.
